title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
desc: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin-the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

title: Yes Boss
desc: Rahul tries to satisfy his demanding and womanizer boss. Rahul has now to choose either to save innocent Seema or to follow his dream of becoming big.

title: Tuk Tuk
desc: Three teenage friends find a mysterious auto-rickshaw that brings excitement to their village and unexpectedly becomes a symbol of hope and change.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

title: Chhatriwali
desc: An unemployed chemistry genius decides to use her knowledge to guide students. She works to break the taboo around sex and the human reproductive system, teaching them with clarity and confidence.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.

title: Haisiyat
desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das takes charge of India's hockey team post-independence and battles challenges and odds to lead them toward Olympic glory and bring pride to the nation.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Silsila Hai Pyar Ka
desc: Vanshika, a simple young woman, is hired by a wealthy man to care for his son. Though the boy is spoiled at first, her presence slowly changes his outlook and their lives forever.
